baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَمْرُهُ ... أَرَادَ شَيْئًا ... يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The restrictive construction compresses the divine affair into a causal chain: volition fixes a knowable object, an addressed directive supplies the operative transition, and the coordinated imperfect marks the object's actual occurrence.

activation_trace.role: The affair or case is the whole operation being reduced to one sufficient mechanism.
The binding request supplies the directive force carried by the imperative.
Volition supplies the selecting intention that precedes the directive.
The knowable and reportable thing supplies a determinate object for the address.
Expressed saying supplies the performative medium of the directive.
Occurrence and presence in time join command and result through the repeated root.

changed_reading.before: God desires a thing and then creates it.
changed_reading.after: The focus itself presents desire, address, command, and occurrence as one closed performative operation with no additional cause named.

baseline_models.mechanism: Because saying can be a thing's own indication, the clause can carry more than an acoustic scene: the imperative specifies the state to be disclosed, and the object's occurrence is the successful disclosure.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication counts as its saying, allowing realized state to function as disclosure.
The reportable thing is capable of being specified and then manifested.
Actual occurrence is the state through which the addressed thing becomes evident.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a spoken formula followed by existence.
changed_reading.after: The saying may denote an effective disclosure whose content and realized event coincide, without requiring ordinary vocal production.

baseline_models.mechanism: The affair shades into jurisdiction and binding order, while the saying shades into the utterance of one whose word takes effect; becoming is therefore the addressed thing's compliance with effective sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Authority and rule supply the jurisdiction within which the command is effective.
The obligatory request supplies the command to which the thing responds.
The effective speaker's word supplies a sovereign rather than conversational register.
The commanded object's occurrence is the concrete effect of that jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The verse is only a statement about creative speed.
changed_reading.after: The verse also models creation as unopposed jurisdiction: authoritative address and the object's compliance are contiguous.

baseline_models.mechanism: The appointment branch of amr combines with the two event thresholds and the temporal occurrence branch of kawn, yielding a possible reading in which willing brings a thing to its marked occasion of manifestation.

activation_trace.role: A mark or appointed time gives the affair a scheduled threshold.
Volition activates the selected appointment rather than leaving it merely potential.
Occurrence in time supplies the event that arrives at the marked threshold.

changed_reading.before: The command is an undifferentiated instantaneous act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command is also the activation of an appointed manifestation: when its selected threshold is reached, the thing occurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated will-conditionals attach volition to sharply different outcomes: harm, drowning, effaced sight, and immobilizing transformation. The focus object is therefore not limited to a newly originated entity; it can be any selected state transition, with the command executing the chosen branch.

activation_trace.role: The focus volition is the selector whose scope is revised by the contextual alternatives.
The focus thing becomes the determinate outcome selected for realization.
Occurrence is the execution stage of the selected outcome.
Will is attached to a possible harmful outcome, showing selection beyond origination.
The will-related branch introduces drowning as one selectable counterfactual state.
The will-related branch introduces loss of sight as another selectable state.
The will-related branch introduces fixed-place transformation as a third selectable state.

structural_cues: 36:23 uses a will conditional for harm, while 36:43, 36:66, and 36:67 repeat conditional willing with different consequences.
The focus shifts from those unrealized if-branches to إذا أراد, the when-branch of selected realization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated conditional outcomes and the focus supplies occurrence; I infer a modal-selection arrow from willing to one realized state. Alternatively, the conditionals may only be separate demonstrations of power rather than a shared selection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Willing initiates the creation of a new object.
changed_reading.after: Willing selects any determinate outcome, including reversal or disablement, and the addressed command moves that selected possibility into occurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence turns a creature made from a drop into an overt disputant who constructs an analogy, forgets his own creation, and voices an objection. Against that discursive chain, the focus saying does not merely counter-propose; it performs the event under dispute.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance becomes the divine counterpart to the creature's voiced objection.
Actual occurrence distinguishes this saying from speech that remains argumentative.
The seminal drop supplies the materially slight origin of the later speaker.
Open disputation gives the creature's speech an adversarial function.
The production and display of an analogy supplies the objection's rhetorical operation.
The posed example supplies a representational claim that cannot itself enact revival.
Loss of remembered origin explains why the speaker treats recreation as impossible.
The creature's spoken question supplies the nonperformative saying contrasted with the focus.

structural_cues: 36:77-82 is one continuous movement from created speaker, to objection, to answer, to the focus formula.
The same saying root occurs in the objection and the focus, but only the focus coordinates saying directly with becoming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the juxtaposed human objection and divine saying; I infer that the shared speech root is contrastive and that occurrence marks executable speech. Alternatively, the focus may simply conclude the proof without commenting on kinds of speech.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a general maxim about effortless creation.
changed_reading.after: In sequence it is also a reply enacted rather than merely argued: human speech makes a doubtful representation, while divine saying makes the represented event occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly crosses states that appear materially discontinuous: dead land lives, a drop becomes a disputant, decayed bone is re-originated, green growth yields fire, and cosmic creation grounds the capacity to make its like. Kun fa-yakunu names the common actualizing operator across origination, revival, and transformation.

activation_trace.role: The unrestricted knowable thing is widened to every contextually displayed state transition.
Occurrence supplies the common endpoint of otherwise different material transitions.
Lifeless land supplies an apparently inert starting state.
Earth brought alive through growth supplies a visible reversal from inertness.
A seminal drop supplies a minute material origin that becomes a complex person.
Decay supplies the state whose apparent irreversibility motivates the objection.
Origination supplies the precedent that makes renewed occurrence coherent.
Fresh green plant matter supplies one side of a deliberately contrary material pairing.
Kindled fire supplies the opposed state latent in the green material.
Ignition supplies the active crossing from green source to burning result.
Origination and bringing-forth supply the encompassing creative precedent.
Effective capacity supplies the ability that carries analogy into actual production.

structural_cues: The dead-earth sign at 36:33 anticipates the human revival dispute at 36:78-79.
The green-tree fire at 36:80 and the heavens-and-earth question at 36:81 escalate from local transformation to comprehensive creative capacity immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several distinct transformations; I infer one cross-state actualization operator culminating in kun fa-yakunu. Alternatively, the examples may remain separate analogical proofs without naming a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Be, and it is concerns only production from nonexistence.
changed_reading.after: Be, and it occurs covers origination, restoration, and transformation whenever a determinate state is willed, even when source and result appear materially opposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice pairs one cry with an immediate fa-idha result, and elsewhere explicitly denies any need to send a host. These enactments make the focus restriction operational: one effective signal is sufficient, without auxiliary force or a narrated chain of fabrication.

activation_trace.role: The binding directive supplies the sufficient operation condensed by the restriction.
The uttered signal supplies the sole named means between will and event.
Occurrence supplies the immediate result of the sufficient directive.
A mutually supporting host is explicitly denied, removing auxiliary force from the mechanism.
The terrifying cry supplies a signal whose effect is immediately complete.
Numerical singleness makes the signal's sufficiency explicit.
The second terrifying cry supplies the parallel signal for universal presence.
A second statement of numerical singleness confirms that no sequence of signals is needed.

structural_cues: 36:29 and 36:53 share إن كانت إلا صيحة واحدة فإذا, closely matching the focus's restrictive and result syntax.
The outcomes differ, extinguishment in 36:29 and universal presence in 36:53, while the one-signal mechanism remains stable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied auxiliary force and two one-signal outcomes; I infer that these scenes enact the focus's economy of causation. Alternatively, the repeated cry may describe eschatological events without specifying how the creative command works.

changed_reading.after: The formula emphasizes sufficiency: a single effective directive exhausts the required operation, whether the result is cessation, assembly, or creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus says to it before reporting its occurrence. Whole-surah enumeration, complete knowledge, and dominion make that pronoun intelligible as address to an already determinate object of knowledge and rule, not to an anonymous or unforeseen result.

activation_trace.role: The knowable and reportable thing supplies the determinate addressee.
Saying directed to the pronominal recipient makes prior determinacy functionally necessary.
Every reportable thing is placed within the scope of comprehensive registration.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies prior specification rather than accidental emergence.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies epistemic determination of every creation.
Sovereignty supplies the governing domain within which every addressee is held.
Every knowable thing closes the surah inside that universal governing scope.

structural_cues: The focus's لَهُ refers to the willed thing before فَيَكُونُ reports occurrence.
كل شيء frames the surah at 36:12 and 36:83, first under enumeration and finally under dominion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior enumeration, knowledge, dominion, and a pronominal addressee; I infer that epistemic and sovereign determination grounds addressability before occurrence. Alternatively, شيء may remain only a universal grammatical object without implying a pre-occurrence specification.

changed_reading.before: A previously indeterminate object appears after the command.
changed_reading.after: The command addresses a fully specified object of knowledge and dominion, and its becoming is the manifestation of that determination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created animals are placed under human disposal and made tractable, rival gods cannot provide effective aid, and the conclusion assigns all sovereignty to God. This social-political field sharpens the focus command as jurisdiction whose objects cannot resist or require external enforcement.

activation_trace.role: Rule and authority supply the focus command's jurisdictional dimension.
Binding command supplies the act to which the object is made responsive.
The object's occurrence is the effective result of the jurisdiction.
Possession and disposal supply a lower-order image of created things placed under authority.
Making difficult things tractable supplies the compliance relation between power and object.
Aid and effective support are denied to rival powers, excluding competing enforcement.
Universal sovereignty closes the jurisdictional mechanism around every thing.

structural_cues: 36:71-75 moves from created property made tractable to powerless rival gods.
36:83 immediately follows the focus by locating the sovereignty of every thing in God's hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, tractability, failed rival aid, and final sovereignty; I infer a compliance arrow from divine jurisdiction to becoming. Alternatively, these social relations may illustrate gratitude and idolatry without defining the ontology of kun.

changed_reading.before: The thing appears because divine power is great enough to make it.
changed_reading.after: The thing becomes because it is already within an uncontested jurisdiction where address is effective and no rival force mediates or blocks compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: When mouths are sealed, hands communicate and feet bear witness. The scene demonstrates intelligible disclosure without ordinary vocal agency, activating the focus branch in which a thing's indication is its saying: realized being can itself be the truthful response to be.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as saying permits the command-event to be read as nonacoustic disclosure.
The thing's actual occurrence supplies the state that discloses successful response.
Intelligible communication by hands supplies speech without the ordinary mouth-speaker channel.
Knowledge-bearing testimony by feet supplies state-based disclosure of truth.

structural_cues: 36:65 explicitly seals mouths before assigning communication and testimony to bodily members.
The focus addresses the thing itself rather than naming a vocal apparatus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonoral communication and the focus inventory supplies saying as indication; I infer that occurrence can be the thing's disclosed answer. Alternatively, miraculous bodily speech may still be literal vocalization and may not generalize to the creative saying.

changed_reading.before: God vocally says a word and the object then exists.
changed_reading.after: The command can be understood as effective intelligible disclosure, with the thing's realized state itself answering and evidencing the directive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured solar motion, apportioned lunar stages, a bounded interval, and a promised event fixed to an occasion activate the appointment branch of amr. The focus can therefore include precise scheduling: the directive is not delay or deliberation but execution at the determinate limit assigned to the thing.

activation_trace.role: A mark or appointed time supplies the focus affair's temporal coordinate.
Occurrence in time supplies execution at that coordinate.
Deliberate apportioning supplies an ordered course rather than random arrival.
A measured limit supplies the moon's staged temporal coordinates.
A thing's proper occasion supplies a bounded interval for continued enjoyment.
A promise fixed to time or place supplies the questioned appointment.
The fulfilled appointment supplies the arrival of what had been temporally marked.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 depicts noncolliding courses and measured stages, a system of exact event placement.
The questioned promise at 36:48 is recognized as fulfilled at 36:52, while the focus repeats the event-threshold particle إذا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured courses, bounded time, and fulfilled appointment; I infer that amr's appointment branch makes kun an exactly placed execution. Alternatively, cosmic scheduling may concern created regularities while the focus describes an unqualified creative act.

changed_reading.before: Immediate efficacy excludes every temporal coordinate.
changed_reading.after: Efficacy excludes failed mediation, not exact placement: when the willed thing's assigned threshold arrives, the directive and occurrence coincide.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر د د mapping behind أَرَادَ rather than the ordinary volition branch. It remains anchored in the supplied focus split and is made coherent by decay, first origination, and final return; downstream prose should present it only as a resurrection-frame echo, never as a replacement lexical gloss for أَرَادَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرَادَ through mapped root root_000555, joined to كُن فَيَكُونُ

activation_trace.role: The packet's alternate return-or-restoration branch supplies a form-distant echo within the focus verb.
Renewed occurrence supplies the destination of the exploratory restoration.
Decayed remains supply the state from which restoration must operate.
First origination supplies the prior constituted state to which revival can answer.
Return to what was supplies the surah-closing orientation that keeps the restoration echo live.

changed_reading.before: The command creates without any return-shaped resonance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily in the resurrection frame, be can sound as a return-to-actuality operation that restores the decayed thing to the occurrence first granted it.

strongest_changes: Repeated will-conditionals recast إرادة as selection among possible state transitions, not only desire for a new entity.
The dispute sequence contrasts representational human speech with divine speech whose proposition becomes executable event.
Dead earth, seminal origin, decayed bone, green-tree fire, and cosmic creation widen كُن فَيَكُونُ into a common operator of origination, restoration, and transformation.
Whole-surah enumeration, knowledge, and dominion make the pre-occurrence pronoun لَهُ point to a determinate object of knowledge and rule.
The repeated single cry and denied host sharpen إنما as sufficiency of one effective directive rather than merely speed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not leave the focus as an isolated creation slogan. It supplied recurrent will-branches, contrasting modes of speech, one-signal enactments, material reversals, exact appointments, and a final sovereignty frame, allowing several distinct but anchored mechanisms to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The indicative and nonvocal readings of قول are branch-supported but need not displace an ordinary utterance reading.
The appointment reading of أمر is coherent with the cosmic sequence but remains less direct than affair or command.
The return-to-actuality outlier depends on a non-dominant mapped root and should remain an explicitly form-distant echo.
The packet supports causal compression, but it does not settle whether فَيَكُونُ should be rendered as temporally immediate, duratively unfolding, or simply certain.
